name: Tandem Footwork
description: When you roll Initiative, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration if you don't have the Incapacitated condition. When you do, roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the Initiative rolls of each ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
